statement.p: Izabelle has {\$76} in her piggy bank. She plans to purchase some Pokemon cards, which costs {\$1.75} each. She plans to save {\$51.50} to purchase another toy. At most how many Pokemon cards can he purchase?
Write an equation to solve this problem.
Izabelle can purchase at most Pokemon cards.

solution.p: Assume Izabelle can purchase x Pokemon cards.
Each card costs {\$1.75}, so x cards will cost 1.75x dollars.
Currently, Izabelle has {\$76} in his piggy bank. After spending 1.75x dollars, he would have 76-1.75x dollars left.
Izabelle will keep {\$51.50} unspent. Now we can write an equation:
Izabelle can purchase at most 14 Pokemon cards.
